hardware.gpu: 8 x NVIDIA L4 (SM89), no cross-NUMA peer access
hardware.cpu: Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU @ 2.20GHz; 96 logical CPUs, two NUMA nodes

method.bytes: complete tensor bytes per rank: AR input / AG output
method.order: a: AR then AG, previous/batch/progress/combined/compact_combined; b: reverse operations and variants
method.sweep_range: min/max of sweep medians, not confidence intervals
method.additional_controls: After the main confirmation, AR CPU-parallel and CPU-parallel-compact run in two reversed-order sweeps without GPU progress. They are separate controls, not extra samples for earlier points.
method.timer: original harness slowest-rank CUDA-event interval; includes host submission gaps; dense eager calls
method.baseline: each variant has its own alternating paired NCCL control; P2P default on within NUMA, SHM across NUMA
method.exclusivity: compute process list checked before and after each sweep; busy GPU aborts
method.screening: preliminary out-of-place AR/AG existing-option sweeps; new_* uses in-place AR, out-of-place AG. Some screening overlapped CPU compilation. Confirmation runs after build/correctness completion.

variants.previous: frozen pre-change binary, existing benchmark defaults (AR compact 4-worker/16-block rule at 128/256 KiB)
variants.cpu_parallel: batch plus --gpu-launch-workers-per-node 4, with CPU progress at every AR size

primary_comparison.selection: one fixed configuration per operation for the entire sweep; router timing and regressions inform this choice, not paired NCCL values; no per-size best variant selection

software.baseline_source_hashes: source_hashes_before.json (37 files verified against baseline commit)
software.build_command: make -C experimental/lite -j2 adaptive-collectives router-checks BUILD=build/ar_ag_transfer_20261113 CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-12.9 CUTLASS_HOME=/data/zhongjie/cutlass-v4.5.0 NCCL_HOME=build/nccl-2.28.9

validation.calibration_replay: auto_replay.json: matching known sizes follow eligibility; exact 1536-byte and changed-threshold keys retain fallback without router initialization

limits: Options are off by default and need fresh exact local calibration.
Parallel eager submission reserves eight extra CPU threads and spins for up to 2 ms; call spacing and affinity matter. New AR/AG sparse-call performance is not measured.
GPU AR arithmetic rounds once in FP32, whereas the CPU path rounds intermediate BF16 NUMA partials.
No additional 2/4-MiB improvement established. No measurements above 4 MiB.
C API and multiprocess drop-in expose no new controls; no application speedup claimed.
reproduction: Copy reproduction scripts into experimental/lite/build/ar_ag_transfer_20261113 before execution, rebuild the current binary there, and reconstruct the baseline from the recorded commit in a separate checkout/build before copying it to collectives_before. Choose fresh output locations/names. Exact commands and clean environments are recorded in raw/*.json. Raw sample CSVs are losslessly gzip compressed.

plots.style: shared figure_style; matches the two-series ReduceScatter README plot
